subject: IAM controls intake & workback for Nimbus SOC2 onboarding
messages:
From: Sarah Gutierrez <sarah.gutierrez@nimbusfin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Wong <paul.wong@nimbusfin.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 10:12:35 -0700
Subject: Request: IAM evidence for SOC2 intake (SCIM / SSO / RBAC)

Hi Karthik,

We're kicking off the Nimbus SOC2 vendor intake for Redwood. Our security team needs a compact IAM evidence package so our auditors can validate identity and access controls. Specifically we need:

- SAML/SSO IdP metadata and sample assertion (test environment)
- SCIM delta logs covering the last 30 days (provisioning + deprovisioning events)
- RBAC snapshot (roles, role-to-permission mapping, and an export of user-role assignments)
- Evidence of periodic access reviews (most recent quarter) and who performed them

Can you confirm whether you can provide those artifacts and a tentative ETA? Our ingestion window for this cohort is Aug 16, so a delivery by Aug 13 would be ideal.

I attached the Nimbus intake checklist (signed) and our minimal redaction guidance — auditors will accept redacted UPNs as long as mapping is provided.

Thanks,
Sarah Gutierrez
Senior Information Security Manager
Nimbus Financial
[attachment: nimbus-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Gutierrez <sarah.gutierrez@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 11:03:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC2 intake (SCIM / SSO / RBAC)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a package and aim for Aug 12 delivery to give you a day to ingest ahead of your window. Plan: 

- Laura will export the RBAC snapshot and the access-review evidence (PDF).
- Marcus will run the SCIM delta export (last 30 days) and produce an event CSV.
- I'll provide SAML metadata, a test assertion sample, and a short narrative describing our SCIM retention/window & redaction process.

We will upload artifacts to the shared folder linked below and post the final manifest once everything is uploaded. Note: some SCIM logs contain internal identifiers — we will provide a redaction map per your guidance.

Target ETA: Aug 12 COB PT. If anything changes we will update you.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:58 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC2 intake (SCIM / SSO / RBAC)

Karthik / Marcus — taking the RBAC and access review work. Quick plan and assignments: 

- RBAC snapshot: I will export roles.csv and role_permissions.csv from the admin console, scrub any internal-only notes, and include a short mapping doc.
- Access review evidence: export of the review results + sign-off PDF (Access Review Admin: Priya N) — redaction note will be included.
- Delivery: I will upload rbac-snapshot-2026Q2.csv and access-review-2026Q2.pdf to the shared folder by EOD Aug 11.

One action item for Marcus: confirm whether the SCIM export will include auth_source in the event records so we can show linkage between provisioning events and SSO identity. If not, we should include a small lookup table.

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:22:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC2 intake (SCIM / SSO / RBAC)

Quick status: SCIM delta export run against provisioning logs for 2026-07-12 through 2026-08-09. I generated a compressed CSV with event_type, timestamp, user_id (redacted token), source, and action. Sample row (redacted):

"event_type","timestamp","user_id","source","action"
"provision","2026-07-21T02:14:03Z","redacted-usr-7f3a","okta-scim","create"

Attachments to upload: scim-sync-logs-2026-07-31.zip (contains CSV), plus a small mapping file scim_user_map_sample.csv showing how we map redacted tokens back to internal IDs for auditors. ETA: I'll upload both to the drive by Aug 12 10:00am PT.

Marcus Lin
Platform Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: scim-sync-logs-2026-07-31.zip (zip, 4.8MB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Gutierrez <sarah.gutierrez@nimbusfin.com>, Paul Wong <paul.wong@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:43:02 -07:00
Subject: Completed: Nimbus IAM evidence upload (shared drive link)

Hi Sarah / Paul — FYI we uploaded the requested artifacts to the shared folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleSharedFolder

Included files (manifest):
- saml-metadata-nimbus.xml (SAML IdP metadata)
- saml-assertion-sample.xml (test assertion, assertions.signed)
- scim-sync-logs-2026-07-31.zip (SCIM delta events CSV inside)
- scim_user_map_sample.csv (redaction map sample)
- rbac-snapshot-2026Q2.csv (role -> permissions)
- access-review-2026Q2.pdf (signed review evidence)
- redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (manifest + notes)

Notes: 
- SCIM export contains redacted user tokens; the scim_user_map_sample.csv provides the mapping auditors requested.
- We redacted direct PII per your guidance; if auditors require unredacted mappings under NDA, let us know and we can arrange a controlled review.

Please confirm receipt when convenient and tell us if you need additional context or an annotated walkthrough — happy to schedule a 30-min call.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence-manifest.txt (txt, 2KB)]
